latestReleaseNotes:
### Release info
Oobee is available as a desktop app for Mac and Windows. The setup files can be downloaded under `Assets` at the bottom of the page.

### Installation Guide
* Refer to the [Installation Guide](https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/blob/master/INSTALLATION.md) for Windows and Mac.

### What's New
In this release, the scan accuracy for DOM elements is more accurate with wait for page to be loaded improvements. It fixes scan stalls where a website continuously blocks subsequent web requests after a period of successful page scans. Other miscellaneous UI bug fixes are included.

#### Improvements
* Export a11yRuleShortDescriptionMap json by @WilsonkwSheng in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/839
* fix(crawler): prevent hostile-site hangs and corrupted results.zip by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/841
* fix(target-size): widen post-scan pruning to notCloseEnoughToEdge and tooManyRects by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/837
* Add custom flow finalizing callback by @WilsonkwSheng in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/844
* Add Inspect preset report layout by @WilsonkwSheng in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/846
* Add OOBEE_ARIA_VALID_ATTR_VALUE_RECHECK_MS flags to delay page before… by @WilsonkwSheng in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/847
* fix: preflight custom flow URLs before headed launch by @WilsonkwSheng in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/845
* Disable abort thresholds by default (avoid killing long scans on transient 403s) by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/848

#### Fixes
* remove: email report feature (patches PowerShell command injection) by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/282
* chore: bump version to v0.10.15 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/283

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/compare/0.11.13...0.11.15
